cards.label: Whitechapel
cards.text: A railway arch nobody's bothered to lock properly in three years. It's held ore the whole time and nothing's ever gone wrong with it - yet.

cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "That one's ours and it's soft as anything. It was fine while nobody's looking twice at us. We're past that now."

choices.label: Fund a lookout (£150)
choices.result_text: You put the money in, so someone doesn't need to pull a second shift and can spend it here, sitting on a crate near the arch most evenings, reading a paper without really reading it.

choices.label: Stay soft and fast
choices.result_text: You leave it as it is. Nobody's ever taken it before, and sometimes a lookout just draws more attention.

cards.text: Either way, the vein keeps doing what it's always done, for now. Whether that keeps being true is a separate question.
